sloka: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाय तं परिष्वज्य सादरम् ।शत्रुघ्नं च परिष्वज्य भरतं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥ २.११२.२६॥
transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñāya taṁ pariṣvajya sādaram ।śatrughnaṁ ca pariṣvajya bharataṁ cedamabravīt ॥ 2.112.26॥

translations.english: 'Be it so', assured Rama and then affectionately embracing both Bharata and Satrughna, said to Bharata:
